## The ecosystem of algorithms

Taxonomy after Shen-Orr & Gannett (2013) and reviews such as
@avilacobosComputationalDeconvolutionTranscriptomics2018,
@gaspard-boulincCelltypeDeconvolutionMethods2025:

::: incremental
- **Partial deconvolution** — estimate proportions $p$ given signature
  $X$
- **Complete deconvolution** — jointly infer $p$ and $X$ (ill-posed
  without priors)
:::

## Granularity

Deconvolution targets vary:

- Mixtures of **cell populations** (e.g. immune fractions)
- Mixtures of **tissues** (e.g. tumour purity)
- Mixtures of **cell-cycle phases**

## Reference-based principle

![Signature $X$, bulk $y$, proportions $p$.](images/deconv-principle-2.png){#fig-deconv-principle fig-alt="Reference-based deconvolution schematic."}

1. Purified cellular profiles (signature matrix $X$)
2. Bulk mixture $y$
3. Estimate proportions $p$ (often with simplex constraints)

Classic tools include DeconRNASeq [@gongDeconRNASeqStatisticalFramework2013],
CIBERSORT [@newmanRobustEnumerationCell2015], and EPIC
[@racleSimultaneousEnumerationCancer2017].

::: {.attribution}
@avilacobosComputationalDeconvolutionTranscriptomics2018
:::

## Signature-based families {#tbl-methods-slide}

Compact survey of common reference-based tools (@tbl-methods):

```{r}
#| label: tbl-methods
#| tbl-cap: "Selected reference-based deconvolution methods."
methods_tbl <- data.frame(
  method = c(
    "DeconRNASeq", "CIBERSORT", "EPIC", "quanTIseq", "FARDEEP"
  ),
  family = c(
    "QP / least squares",
    "SVR (robust)",
    "Weighted QP",
    "Weighted QP",
    "Robust regression"
  ),
  citation = c(
    "Gong & Szustakowski, 2013",
    "Newman et al., 2015",
    "Racle et al., 2017",
    "Finotello et al., 2018",
    "Hao et al., 2019"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

reactable::reactable(
  methods_tbl,
  columns = list(
    method = reactable::colDef(name = "Method", minWidth = 110),
    family = reactable::colDef(name = "Family", minWidth = 140),
    citation = reactable::colDef(name = "Citation", minWidth = 160)
  ),
  bordered = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  wrap = FALSE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  defaultPageSize = 8,
  style = list(fontSize = "0.85rem"),
  theme = reactable::reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#d0d7de",
    headerStyle = list(
      backgroundColor = "#053660",
      color = "#ffffff",
      fontWeight = 600
    )
  )
)
```

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Regression**

- Quadratic programming (DeconRNASeq)
- Robust / SVR (CIBERSORT, FARDEEP)
- Weighted QP (EPIC, quanTIseq)
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Probabilistic**

- Continuous: DSection, DeMix
- Discrete: PERT, TEMT
:::
:::::
